data.body:
**[P2] Serialize wrapper installation on a shared tracer**

Concurrent factory calls construct plugins that perform unsynchronized check-then-set installation of `DeterministicIdGenerator` and `DurableSampler`. If a configured provider caches and returns one tracer, two first invocations can each wrap the original generator; the losing plugin retains a wrapper the tracer no longer uses, so its deterministic overrides are ignored and workflow/operation span IDs become random, breaking cross-invocation stitching. Make installation atomic and return the winning wrappers, covering both factory classes with a shared-tracer concurrency test.
